---
title: "Formula sheet"
---

The main results of each module, with links to their derivations. Each result holds only under its
module's assumptions; read those before using it. Every formula here is checked by a test in
`tests/`.

## m03 · Unipolar, bipolar and omnipolar electrograms

Symbols: $\sigma$ conductivity, $i_m$ membrane current per area, $V_m$ transmembrane voltage,
$h$ electrode height, $w$ front width, $c$ conduction velocity, $d$ spacing, $\theta$ angle between
bipole and propagation, $k$ spatial frequency, $r_e$ electrode radius, $s$ distance from the front.
Model: a thin tissue sheet in an infinite homogeneous conductor and a planar front.

**Unipolar potential, thin sheet in an infinite homogeneous conductor** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-volume-conductor))

$$
\phi(\mathbf r, t) = \frac{1}{4\pi\sigma} \iint \frac{i_m(\mathbf r', t)}{\lVert \mathbf r - \mathbf r' \rVert}\, dA'
$$

**Membrane current from the voltage profile** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-cable))

$$
i_m = \beta\,\frac{\partial^2 V_m}{\partial x^2}
$$

**Height filter** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-height-filter))

$$
\hat\phi(k) = \frac{e^{-|k| h}}{2\sigma |k|}\, \hat i_m(k)
$$

**Unipolar electrogram for a planar arctangent front** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-unipolar-closed))

$$
U(s) = A\,\frac{s}{s^2 + a^2},
\qquad
A = \frac{\beta\,\Delta V}{2\pi\sigma},
\qquad
a = w + h
$$

**Unipolar slope** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-unipolar-slope))

$$
\frac{dU}{dt} = -c\,\frac{dU}{ds}
$$

**Bipolar electrogram (distal minus proximal)** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-bipolar))

$$
V_{\text{bip}}(t) = \phi(\mathbf r_1, t) - \phi(\mathbf r_2, t),
\qquad
\mathbf r_{1,2} = \mathbf r_0 \pm \tfrac{d}{2}\,\hat u
$$

**Close bipole** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-bipolar-gradient))

$$
V_{\text{bip}} \approx d\, \hat u \cdot \nabla \phi = d \cos\theta\, \frac{dU}{ds}
$$

**Disk electrode average** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-disk-average))

$$
H_{\text{disk}}(k) = \frac{2 J_1(k r_e)}{k r_e}
$$

**Bipole transfer function** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-bipolar-transfer))

$$
H_{\text{bip}}(k) = 2i \sin\!\left( \frac{k d \cos\theta}{2} \right),
\qquad
|H_{\text{bip}}| = 2 \left| \sin\!\left( \frac{k d \cos\theta}{2} \right) \right|
$$

**Far-field decay at distance R** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-farfield))

$$
\phi_{\text{monopole}} \propto \frac{1}{R},\quad V_{\text{bip}} \propto \frac{d}{R^2};
\qquad
\phi_{\text{dipole}} \propto \frac{1}{R^2},\quad V_{\text{bip}} \propto \frac{d}{R^3}
$$

**Electric field from a clique (least squares)** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-clique-field))

$$
\hat{\mathbf E}(t) = -\left( D D^{\mathsf T} \right)^{-1} D\, \mathbf b(t)
$$

**Omnipolar signal** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-omnipole))

$$
v_\omega(t) = -d\, \hat\omega \cdot \hat{\mathbf E}(t)
$$

**Conduction velocity from one clique** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-clique-velocity))

$$
c \approx \frac{\mathrm{pp}\left( dU/dt \right)}{\mathrm{pp}\left( \hat n \cdot \hat{\mathbf E} \right)}
$$

## m37 · AI on the surface ECG

Symbols: $z_c$ class score, $p_c$ probability, $y_c$ label, $w[k]$ kernel weight, $f_s$ sampling rate, $k_l$ and $s_l$
kernel width and stride of layer $l$, $RR_i$ an RR interval, $\pi$ prevalence, Se and Sp sensitivity and specificity.
Model: a classifier that outputs class probabilities; the prior-shift result needs calibrated probabilities and
unchanged class-conditional recordings.

**Softmax** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-softmax))

$$
p_c = \frac{e^{z_c}}{\sum_{j=1}^{C} e^{z_j}}
$$

**Cross-entropy gradient** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-ce-grad))

$$
\frac{\partial L}{\partial z_c} = p_c - y_c
$$

**Logistic regression** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-logistic))

$$
p = \sigma(\beta_0 + \boldsymbol\beta^{\mathsf T}\mathbf x), \qquad \sigma(u) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-u}}
$$

**Convolution layer** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-conv))

$$
y[n] = b + \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} w[k]\, x[s n + k]
$$

**Kernel frequency response** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-kernel-response))

$$
H(f) = \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} w[k]\, e^{-i 2\pi f k / f_s}
$$

**Receptive field** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-receptive-field))

$$
r = 1 + \sum_{l=1}^{L} (k_l - 1) \prod_{j<l} s_j
$$

**RR-interval features** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-rr))

$$
\overline{RR}, \qquad
\mathrm{CV} = \frac{s_{RR}}{\overline{RR}}, \qquad
\mathrm{nRMSSD} = \frac{1}{\overline{RR}} \sqrt{\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n-1} \left(RR_{i+1} - RR_i\right)^2 }
$$

**Screening yield** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-yield))

$$
N_{+} = N\left[\pi\,\mathrm{Se} + (1-\pi)(1-\mathrm{Sp})\right], \qquad
\frac{N_{+}}{N\pi\,\mathrm{Se}} = \frac{1}{\mathrm{PPV}}
$$

**Prior-shift correction** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-prior-shift))

$$
p' = \frac{\dfrac{\pi'}{\pi}\, p}{\dfrac{\pi'}{\pi}\, p + \dfrac{1-\pi'}{1-\pi}\,(1-p)}
$$

## m38 · Wearables and implantable monitors

Symbols: $RR_i$ beat intervals, $\Delta_i$ pulse delays, $\mathrm{IBI}_i$ pulse intervals, $q$ and $p$ per-window
flag rates in regular rhythm and AF, $k$ windows required in a row, $n$ windows per day, $L$ windows per episode,
$N$ patients, $\lambda$ alerts per patient per day, $\tau$ review minutes, $\kappa$ and $r$ shares of true alerts
kept and false alerts removed. Model: independent windows and alerts.

**Heart rate** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-hr))

$$
\mathrm{HR} = \frac{60}{\overline{\mathrm{IBI}}} \quad \text{beats per minute}
$$

**Pulse intervals** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-ibi))

$$
\mathrm{IBI}_i = RR_i + \left(\Delta_{i+1} - \Delta_i\right)
$$

**Pulse-interval variance** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-ibi-var))

$$
\operatorname{Var}(\mathrm{IBI}) = \operatorname{Var}(RR) + 2\sigma_\Delta^2\,(1 - \rho)
$$

**False notifications, k in a row** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-runs))

$$
\mathbb E[\text{runs}] = q^{k}\left[1 + (n - k)(1 - q)\right]
$$

**Episode caught** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-detect))

$$
a_m = \sum_{j=0}^{k-1} p^{j}(1 - p)\, a_{m-j-1}, \qquad P(\text{episode caught}) = 1 - a_L
$$

**Review load** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-workload))

$$
A = N\lambda, \qquad A_{\text{false}} = N\lambda\,(1 - \mathrm{PPV}), \qquad H = \frac{N\lambda\,\tau}{60}\ \text{hours}
$$

**PPV after a triage filter** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-filter))

$$
\mathrm{PPV}' = \frac{\kappa\,\mathrm{PPV}}{\kappa\,\mathrm{PPV} + (1 - r)(1 - \mathrm{PPV})}
$$

## m39 · AI on electrograms and maps

Symbols: $A$ mesh adjacency matrix, $I$ identity, $\tilde D$ degree matrix of $A + I$, $H$ vertex features, $W$ shared
weights, $\sigma$ nonlinearity, $\mathbf v$ eigenvector with $v_i \propto \sqrt{\tilde d_i}$, $P$ and $T$ predicted and true regions,
$R$ and $r$ disc radii, $d$ centre distance, $p_t$ probability of the true class, $\alpha$ and $\gamma$ focal-loss
weight and focusing parameters, $\pi_k$, $\mu_k$, $\sigma_k$ mixture weights, means and standard deviations, $\gamma_{ik}$
responsibilities.

**Graph convolution layer** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-gcn))

$$
H' = \sigma\!\left(\hat A H W\right), \qquad
\hat A = \tilde D^{-1/2}\,(A + I)\,\tilde D^{-1/2}
$$

**Fixed point of the normalized adjacency** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-smoothing))

$$
\hat A\, \mathbf v = \mathbf v, \qquad v_i \propto \sqrt{\tilde d_i}
$$

**Dice coefficient** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-dice))

$$
\mathrm{Dice} = \frac{2\,\lvert P \cap T \rvert}{\lvert P \rvert + \lvert T \rvert}
$$

**Overlap of two discs (lens area)** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-lens))

$$
\lvert P \cap T\rvert = r^2 \cos^{-1}\!\frac{d^2 + r^2 - R^2}{2dr} + R^2 \cos^{-1}\!\frac{d^2 + R^2 - r^2}{2dR}
- \tfrac12\sqrt{(-d + r + R)(d + r - R)(d - r + R)(d + r + R)}
$$

**Focal loss** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-focal))

$$
\mathrm{FL}(p_t) = -\alpha_t\,(1 - p_t)^{\gamma}\,\log p_t
$$

**Gaussian mixture responsibilities** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-gmm))

$$
\gamma_{ik} = \frac{\pi_k\, \mathcal N(x_i \mid \mu_k, \sigma_k)}{\sum_{j=1}^{K} \pi_j\, \mathcal N(x_i \mid \mu_j, \sigma_j)}
$$
